title: Ctrl-A: Control-Driven Machine Learning using Adaptive Online Data Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2603.21819v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce ControlAugment (Ctrl-A), an automated data augmentation algorithm for image-vision tasks, which incorporates principles from control theory for online adjustment of augmentation strength distributions during model training. Ctrl-A eliminates the need for initialization of individual augmentation strengths. Instead, augmentation strength distributions are dynamically, and individually, adapted during training based on a control-loop architecture and what we define as relative operation response curves. Using an operation-dependent update procedure provides Ctrl-A with the potential to reduce the use of augmentation operations that negatively impact model performance, alleviating the need to manually engineer augmentation policies for new image classification tasks. translated_title: Ctrl-A：基于自适应在线数据增强的控制驱动机器学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ControlAugment（Ctrl-A），一种面向图像视觉任务的自动化数据增强算法，该算法融入控制理论原理，用于在模型训练过程中在线调整增强强度分布。Ctrl-A无需对各增强操作的强度进行初始化，而是在训练过程中基于控制回路架构以及我们定义的“相对操作响应曲线”，对增强强度分布进行动态且独立的自适应调整。这种依赖具体操作的更新机制使Ctrl-A有潜力减少对模型性能产生负面影响的增强操作的使用，从而减轻了为新的图像分类任务手动设计增强策略的负担。在使用WideResNet-28-10和ResNet架构的CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN-core和Tiny ImageNet基准数据集上的实验表明……
tldr: Ctrl-A是一种融合控制理论的自动化数据增强算法，通过控制回路架构在训练中动态自适应地调整各增强操作的强度分布，无需初始化或手动设计增强策略，从而提升图像分类任务的性能。
en_tdlr: Ctrl-A is an automated data augmentation algorithm that incorporates control theory principles, dynamically adapting augmentation strength distributions during training via a control-loop architecture, eliminating the need for initialization or manual policy engineering in image classification tasks.
